specs.Connector Type: USB Type A, USB Type C
specs.Other Special Features of the Product: Digital Display, Fast Charging, Over Charging Protection, Short Circuit Protection, Slim

features: 22.5W USB-A output: Supplies up to 22.5W through the USB-A port. A compatible device and cable are required; actual charging speed varies by device and conditions.
Bidirectional USB-C: The Type-C port supplies up to 20W output and accepts up to 18W input, so the same port charges the power bank and a connected device.
10000mAh with digital display: The lithium-polymer battery has a rated capacity of 10000mAh, while the screen shows the remaining battery percentage.
Dual-device charging: Connect one device to USB-A and another to USB-C. Power is shared between the ports when both are used together.
Pass-through charging: Recharge the power bank while it supplies power to a connected device. Charging speed may vary during simultaneous operation.
Protection and build: Includes over-voltage, over-current, short-circuit and temperature protection, a textured matte grip, BIS-registered and Made in India origin.
